title: BEST FOOD TOUR IN GRANADA
text:
Thank you, Katia, for an amazing evening exploring great venues for excellent food and exceptional wines. Only one other couple was on this tour: Robert and Vanessa. We had such a fun evening with them and Katia, chatting about our own home cultures, work and families. Do not hesitate to book this tour; it's one of the best, and we have done many in different cities. 
My only tip is that the meeting point is by one of the tourist kiosks near the map point.
author: srrayr

title: Excellent food and wine tour.
text: Such a great tour. Definitely value for money and out tour guide was so knowledgeable. Would definitely recommend
author: Wendy0705

title: Granada Tapas and Wine tour
text: An excellent evening hosted by the lovely Katia who took great care of the group. Plentiful local food and wine in the 3 establishments we visited and a couple of very tasty stop offs at some artisan producers
author: Alan_P

title: Great for a solo traveler
text: Marcel was so knowledgeable about all things food and Granada.  He was also incredibly helpful after the tour when I needed recommendations for a specific activity i wanted to do. This was the second thing I did after a walking tour.    I would highly recommend this activity to get to know Granada.  I was alone and met several terrific people.
author: bethocean

title: Nov 26 in Granada
text: Very nice experience but there were just 3 of us. A few more guests would have nice but it was still very good
author: P1929TDchrisr

title: A great tour with food, wine, and history
text: This was an excellent tour, Marcel was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the tour a delight. This worked really well for us as Australians with limited Spanish and was a great introduction to the city.
author: K5055ZRarim

title: Tapas and Wine Tour - A MUST DO!
text: Manuel is exceptional! A stand out tour amongst the rest, quite honestly. The tapas, wines and vermouth absolutely exceptional! The history, culture, terroir behind each dish, wine and vermouth, equally exceptional! A MUST DO with Manuel. Our small group from around the world matched the experience.
author: 21melanit

title: Memorable Night
text: Absolutely fantastic night.  Katia was a wealth of knowledge, picked some amazing places for us to wine and dine, and have the say the entire group was just perfect.  Thanks so much Katia for organising, the lady for trusting an Englishman to guide her around Granada, the NASA ladies for great talk and everyone else who was such a delight.  Really was a memorable night.
author: D2218GYjasonh

title: Amazing night!!
text: Absolutely fantastic experience with Katie!!  Amazing company, guide was fantastic, 100% recommend!!!!
author: JMH71

title: Our family had a fun and...
text: Our family had a fun and educational tour of several shops, restaurants and tapas bars over lunchtime. Would definitely recommend!
author: James_C
